rationale: The assistant agreed a cracked lower spray arm explains the dirty bottom rack and, after the customer's findings, guided them to identify the correct arm by model and product code without quoting a part number. It handled the limescale and the mount check sensibly and avoided compatibility claims. Minor issues: it did not tell the customer to switch the machine off before removing the arm, and the product-code and old-arm comparison advice was repeated across turns. It also declined the offered product code, though that was honest about its limits.
